newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees more improvement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino sees more improvement.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd said on Tuesday that its operating performance would continue to improve over the coming months.

"I am confident that our performance will continue to improve in the coming months with the injection of big name entertainers, more promotions and access to more than 1,000 spaces at the permanent casino car park in December," chairman Dick Warburton said in a statement.
Sydney Harbour earlier reported an operating profit before abnormals and tax of A$14.7 million in the three months to September 30, up 21 percent from the June quarter.
Warburton said profit after tax was $200,000 for the September quarter.

"This includes an abnormal payment of nearly $2 million in pre-opening costs which related to bank charges and refinancing costs for the enhanced themeing and early opening of the permanent casino," Warburton said.
Warburton said earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) for the September quarter was A$26.1 million, an increase of A$3 million or 13 percent on the previous quarter.
The EBITDA for the first 12 months of operations from September 1995, was $106.1 million, Warburton said.
The Sydney casino opened a temporary casino in September 1995 and expects to open a permanent casino in November 1997.
At 10.15 a.m. (2315 GMT), Sydney Harbour shares were three cents higher at A$1.77.
